ROADMAP FOR PH. President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr. leads the launch and ceremonial turnover of the World Bank Group Philippines Country Partnership Framework (CPF) for Fiscal Years 2026-2031 at Kalayaan Hall, Malacañan Palace, July 29, 2025. During the event, President Marcos receives the CPF. CPF serves as a strategic roadmap for the World Bank Group’s engagement in the Philippines, focusing on investments in health, education, job creation, digitization, and resilience. Joining the president onstage are (left to right) Secretary Arsenio Balisacan and Dandan Chen, Operations Manager, World Bank. PPA POOL
